limitations: Harmonic ranges are a dark patch starting region informed by the separate dry-one-shot corpus, not fitted MP3 stem harmonic distributions.
The proposed ADSR gate-follow fields are not implemented by the existing timed holdSeconds/decaySeconds voice API.
Punch exponential time constant, pitch at 8-14ms, and settling time are different measurements.
Demucs bass envelopes contain kick ducking and recovery; recovery is not an 808 attack.
A strongest FFT peak may be the second harmonic; consult YIN-supported estimates.
Do not derive pitch attack from the rejected zero-crossing estimates.
Drive knob values are not transferable between nonlinear circuits.
Gate, natural decay and release are separate; a fixed short one-shot cannot execute a long held note faithfully.
